finding: scripts/lib/daily-task-board.mjs 的 recoverArtifact 在 ledger 中座位状态为 generation_started 且无 artifact 时会扫描本地 artifacts 目录；如果 crash 发生在 writeFileSync 之后、saveLedger 之前，且同一日期同一 agent 仅存在一个不可变 artifact，它可以恢复。但 scripts/run-daily-tasks.mjs 的 runReservedSeat 在 call() 返回非 ok 时会无条件写入一个 artifact 文件并设置 seat.status='incomplete_or_failed'，然后 saveLedger；当进程在 writeFileSync 与 saveLedger 之间被杀死时，recoverArtifact 的前置状态仍是 generation_started，扫描到的 artifact 通过 validateArtifact 时 body.status !== 'complete' 会抛 artifact_binding_invalid，导致 matches 为空、恢复失败，座位永久卡在 generation_started。syncDailyBoard 随后把 generation_started 改成 generation_unknown_no_repurchase，造成该席位永远不会进入 submitted_pending_review，形成真实断点。
verification_commands: node -e "import('./scripts/lib/daily-task-board.mjs').then(m=>{const root='/tmp/ltzzz-recover';const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync(root+'/knowledge/results/daily-board/artifacts',{recursive:true});const date='2026-11-12';const runKey='test:1';const agent='deepseek';const hash='a'.repeat(64);const record={date,run_key:runKey,source_commit:'c'.repeat(40),seats:{[agent]:{agent,status:'generation_started',claim_verified:true,assignment:{id:'DAILY-'+date+'-'+agent,execution_date:date}}}};const artifact={date,run_key:runKey,source_commit:'c'.repeat(40),task_id:'DAILY-'+date+'-'+agent,logical_seat:agent,status:'incomplete_or_failed',output:'x'};const bytes=Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(artifact));const sha=require('crypto').createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');fs.writeFileSync(root+'/knowledge/results/daily-board/artifacts/'+date+'-'+agent+'-'+sha+'.json',bytes);const ok=m.recoverArtifact(root,record,agent,record.seats[agent]);console.log(ok,record.seats[agent].status,record.seats[agent].artifact?.sha256===sha)})"
